summary: Spec fidelity (scenario/brief text, planner-owned; the code matches the approved design): gate.tombstone-corpus.01's When/Then say `gate check` and `status` run 'there, and in a shallow clone of it' and neither reports stale-evidence nor counts the cell. The tombstone lives only in the gitignored scenario index (.canon/ledger/kind=scenario/ is in .canon/.gitignore), so a real clone does not carry it. Probed with the real binary on the post-sync repo: `git clone` (full) -> gate check reports stale-evidence gone.leaf.01 (unchanged from 0.39); `git clone --depth 1` -> staleness_unresolvable advisory naming gone.leaf.01. The test only passes the shallow-clone Then after `copy_dir`-ing the repo's index into the clone (and asserts the uncopied clone still counts the cell), which is not what a clone is. So the fix holds only in a work tree that ran `inventory sync` (or kept its index), not in CI/fresh checkouts. Ask: amend the scenario/brief wording (the Then holds for a clone that carries the index) or choose a design that survives a clone. Blast radius: CI and any fresh checkout of a repo whose last feature file was deleted still go red exactly as in 0.39.
